title: Sony's new see-through DualSense controllers let you game like its 1999

claims.claim: Sony announced new transparent DualSense PS5 controllers named the Prism Collection.

evidence.quote: Sony just announced some nifty-looking transparent DualSense PS5 controllers, recalling the glory days of the late 1990s and early 2000s when many tech gadgets boasted see-through designs. The Prism Collection will be available in three colorways

claims.claim: The Prism Collection controllers will be available in three colorways: orange, green, and gray.

evidence.quote: The Prism Collection will be available in three colorways, including orange, green and gray.

claims.claim: Sony is also releasing matching PS5 console plate covers in the same three colorways.

evidence.quote: The controllers are joined by console plate covers, which are available in the same three colorways.

claims.claim: Preorders for the new items begin directly from PlayStation on November 10.

evidence.quote: Everything will be available to preorder directly from PlayStation beginning on November 10

claims.claim: Shipments for the new products will go out in February.

evidence.quote: with shipments going out in February.
The DualSense controllers cost $85
and the console covers cost $75.

claims.claim: Sony first began dabbling in translucent controllers during the PS1 era.

evidence.quote: Sony first began dabbling in translucent controllers during the PS1 era.
